name: TIC 350334344
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 15.4 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,176 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.04 solar masses and 15.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,525 K at its surface.
